description: Where one settled UFC bout was fought and who held control (tracked reliably from 2007): seconds standing, at distance, in the clinch and on the ground, each fighter's control time by position (clinch, back, mount, side, half guard, guard), and strikes landed and attempted by position and target, for the whole bout and per round. null means not tracked for that bout, 0 is a real zero. Settled bouts only. Pro plans and up.

fight_id.description: Bout id, as returned on an event card. Integer or numeric string.
